class.name: DV_KPI_Tile
class.brief_description: Compact KPI display tile with title, value, delta indicator, optional icon/subtitle/footnote, and a sparkline.
class.description:
[code]DV_KPI_Tile[/code] is a lightweight dashboard control for showing a single metric ("key performance indicator"). It renders: - A [member title] with optional [member title_color]. - A formatted main value built from [member prefix] + [member value] + [member suffix]. - A delta arrow/tint using [member delta] and the style colors [member delta_positive] / [member delta_negative]. - An optional [member subtitle] and [member footnote]. - An optional [member icon] drawn at [member icon_size]. - A small sparkline driven by [member sparkline]. The value scaling can be automatic ([method is_sparkline_autoscale]) or fixed via [method set_sparkline_range].
This control is typically used in grids to summarize trends at a glance and can be made interactive via [signal tile_clicked].
[codeblocks] [gdscript]
extends DV_KPI_Tile
func _ready(): set_title("Daily Revenue") custom_minimum_size = Vector2(260, 140)
set_value(12843.0) set_delta(+3.8) set_prefix("$") set_suffix("") set_subtitle("Last 24h") set_footnote("vs. yesterday")
set_sparkline(PackedFloat32Array([0.1, 0.25, 0.21, 0.28, 0.34, 0.31, 0.36, 0.38])) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_sparkline_range
method.description: Returns the explicit sparkline range as [code]Vector2(min, max)[/code] when autoscaling is disabled. If autoscaling is enabled, this returns the last configured manual range (useful for inspection).

method.name: is_sparkline_autoscale
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the sparkline scales its Y-axis to the data automatically. When [code]true[/code], any manual range set via [method set_sparkline_range] is ignored for rendering.

method.name: set_sparkline_autoscale
method.description: Enables or disables sparkline autoscaling. Set to [code]false[/code] to enforce a fixed Y-range configured with [method set_sparkline_range].

method.name: set_sparkline_range
method.description: Sets the fixed Y-range for the sparkline. Effective only when autoscaling is disabled via [method set_sparkline_autoscale]([code]false[/code]). The control expects [code]min < max[/code]; invalid ranges may be clamped or ignored internally.

members.member: Color used to indicate a negative [member delta] (e.g., down arrow or red tint).
Color used to indicate a positive [member delta] (e.g., up arrow or green tint).
Pixel size for [member icon] when provided.
The percentage or absolute change displayed next to the main value. The sign determines positive/negative styling. Formatting is handled by the control's theme/presentation.
Small auxiliary text rendered at the bottom of the tile (e.g., "vs. yesterday").
Optional icon drawn in the header area of the tile.
String placed before [member value] when displayed (e.g., currency symbol).
Secondary label beneath the main title (e.g., "Last 24h").
String placed after [member value] when displayed (e.g., units).
Main heading text shown at the top of the tile.
Optional override color for the title. If fully transparent, the theme default is used.
The primary numeric value displayed by the tile.
Time-ordered values used to draw the small trend line beneath the KPI. Combine with [method set_sparkline_autoscale] and [method set_sparkline_range] to control vertical scaling.

signal.name: tile_clicked
signal.description: Emitted when the tile is clicked. Use this to trigger drill-down or navigation behaviors.
